title: Hydraulic Fluid Power - Cylinders - Bore and Rod Area Ratios
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11146) covers Hydraulic Fluid Power - Cylinders - Bore and Rod Area Ratios. This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) which is identical with ISO 7181 : 1991 'Hydraulic fluid power — Cylinders — Bore and rod area ratios' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Power Secttonal Committee and approval of the Production Engineering Division Council. This standard was first published in 1984 by adopting ISO 7181 : 1982. The ISO Standard has since been revised as ISO 7181 : 1991. To align this standard with International practices, the Sectional Committee (PE 14), dealing with the subject has decided to revise IS 1 1 146 : 1984 by adopting the above ISO Standard as dual number Indian Standard. In hydraulic fluid power systems, power is transmitted and controlled through a liquid under pressure within an enclosed circuit. One component of such systems is the hydraulic cylinder.
